```{r setup}
# Make sure unicode (−, ↓, ↑) survives in non-UTF-8 shells / CI
if (!l10n_info()$`UTF-8`) {
  for (loc in c("en_US.UTF-8", "C.UTF-8")) if (nzchar(Sys.setlocale("LC_CTYPE", loc))) break
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(highcharter)
  library(htmltools)
})
source("R/data_cache.R")
source("R/performance.R")

tickers <- toupper(trimws(unlist(strsplit(paste(params$tickers, collapse = ","), ","))))
tickers <- unique(tickers[tickers != ""])

UP   <- "#0f8a6e"
DOWN <- "#d1344b"
DEFAULT_PERIOD <- "1M"
```

```{r helpers}
chart_id <- function(ticker) paste0("chart-", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", ticker))

stock_chart <- function(stock, perf) {
  # Only ship the longest period (5Y) to the browser
  p <- stock$prices
  p <- p[index(p) >= as.Date(as.POSIXct(min(perf$min_ms) / 1000, tz = "UTC"))]
  ohlc <- p[, c("Open", "High", "Low", "Close")]
  default <- perf[perf$key == DEFAULT_PERIOD, ]

  hc <- highchart(type = "stock") |>
    hc_yAxis_multiples(create_yaxis(2, height = c(3, 1), turnopposite = TRUE)) |>
    hc_add_series(ohlc, type = "candlestick", name = stock$ticker, yAxis = 0,
                  color = DOWN, lineColor = DOWN,
                  upColor = UP, upLineColor = UP) |>
    hc_add_series(p$Volume, type = "column", name = "Volume", yAxis = 1,
                  color = "#9aa5b1") |>
    hc_rangeSelector(enabled = FALSE) |>
    hc_navigator(enabled = TRUE) |>
    hc_scrollbar(enabled = FALSE) |>
    hc_tooltip(split = TRUE, valueDecimals = 2) |>
    hc_chart(
      height = 520,
      events = list(load = JS(sprintf(
        "function () { this.xAxis[0].setExtremes(%.0f, %.0f); }",
        default$min_ms, attr(perf, "max_ms")
      )))
    )
  hc$elementId <- chart_id(stock$ticker)
  hc
}

perf_strip <- function(stock, perf) {
  max_ms <- attr(perf, "max_ms")
  buttons <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(perf)), function(i) {
    r <- perf[i, ]
    cls <- if (is.na(r$ret)) "flat" else if (r$ret < 0) "neg" else "pos"
    tags$button(
      type = "button",
      class = paste("perf-btn", if (r$key == DEFAULT_PERIOD) "active"),
      `data-chart` = chart_id(stock$ticker),
      `data-min` = sprintf("%.0f", r$min_ms),
      `data-max` = sprintf("%.0f", max_ms),
      span(class = "perf-label", r$label),
      span(class = paste("perf-value", cls), format_pct(r$ret))
    )
  })
  div(class = "perf-strip", buttons)
}

section_id <- function(ticker) paste0("sec-", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", ticker))

stock_section <- function(ticker, stock) {
  if (is.null(stock)) {
    return(div(class = "stock-section", id = section_id(ticker),
               h2(ticker), p(class = "error", "Could not load data for this ticker.")))
  }
  perf <- compute_performance(stock$prices)
  last <- tail(stock$prices, 1)
  day  <- perf$ret[perf$key == "1D"]
  as_of <- format(as.Date(index(last)), "%b %d, %Y")

  div(
    class = "stock-section",
    id = section_id(ticker),
    a(class = "back-top", href = "#summary", "↑ Summary"),
    div(
      class = "stock-header",
      h2(class = "stock-title", stock$name, span(class = "stock-ticker", ticker)),
      div(
        class = "stock-price",
        span(class = "price", formatC(as.numeric(last$Close), format = "f",
                                      digits = 2, big.mark = ",")),
        span(class = paste("day-change", if (!is.na(day) && day < 0) "neg" else "pos"),
             format_pct(day)),
        span(class = "as-of", paste("Close", as_of))
      )
    ),
    perf_strip(stock, perf),
    stock_chart(stock, perf)
  )
}
```

```{r load-data}
stocks <- setNames(lapply(tickers, get_stock,
                          ttl_hours = params$ttl_hours,
                          force = isTRUE(params$refresh)), tickers)
```

```{r summary-table}
library(reactable)

summary_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tickers, function(tk) {
  s <- stocks[[tk]]
  if (is.null(s)) return(NULL)
  perf <- compute_performance(s$prices)
  ret <- setNames(as.list(perf$ret), perf$key)
  data.frame(ticker = tk, name = s$name,
             price = as.numeric(tail(s$prices$Close, 1)),
             currency = s$currency, ret, chart = section_id(tk),
             check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))

pct_col <- function(label) colDef(
  name = label, minWidth = 90, align = "right",
  sortNALast = TRUE,
  cell = function(value) format_pct(value),
  style = function(value) {
    if (is.na(value)) list(color = "#9ca3af")
    else list(color = if (value < 0) DOWN else UP, fontWeight = 500)
  }
)

ret_cols <- setNames(lapply(unname(PERIODS), pct_col), names(PERIODS))

div(
  id = "summary",
  h2(class = "summary-title", "Performance"),
  reactable(
    summary_df,
    searchable = TRUE,
    highlight = TRUE,
    compact = TRUE,
    defaultPageSize = 100,
    defaultColDef = colDef(headerClass = "rt-head"),
    columns = c(
      list(
        ticker = colDef(
          name = "Ticker", minWidth = 80, sticky = "left",
          cell = function(value) span(class = "rt-ticker", value)
        ),
        name = colDef(show = FALSE),
        price = colDef(
          name = "Price", minWidth = 85, align = "right",
          cell = function(value) formatC(value, format = "f", digits = 2, big.mark = ",")
        ),
        currency = colDef(show = FALSE)
      ),
      ret_cols,
      list(chart = colDef(
        name = "", sortable = FALSE, minWidth = 80, align = "center",
        cell = function(value) a(class = "rt-jump", href = paste0("#", value), "Chart ↓")
      ))
    )
  )
)
```

```{r sections}
tagList(lapply(tickers, function(tk) stock_section(tk, stocks[[tk]])))
```

<script>
document.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
  const btn = ev.target.closest(".perf-btn");
  if (!btn || !window.Highcharts) return;
  const id = btn.dataset.chart;
  const chart = Highcharts.charts.find(c => c && c.renderTo &&
    (c.renderTo.id === id || c.renderTo.closest("#" + CSS.escape(id))));
  if (!chart) return;
  chart.xAxis[0].setExtremes(Number(btn.dataset.min), Number(btn.dataset.max));
  btn.parentElement.querySelectorAll(".perf-btn")
     .forEach(b => b.classList.toggle("active", b === btn));
});
</script>
